name: Resolve a channel's wiki page

context:
GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/context_layer/channel-pages/{channel_id}/
The organization's context wiki: a git repo of Markdown pages hosted by PostHog.

name: List dream runs
description: List dream runs The active dreaming task, when present, plus every landed run newest first. GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/context_layer/dreams/
context:
GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/context_layer/dreams/
The active dreaming task, when present, plus every landed run newest first. A landed run is one merge commit `dream: ` whose body is the summary; its changes are on the detail read.

name: Read a wiki page
description: Read a wiki page The organization's context wiki: a git repo of Markdown pages hosted by PostHog. GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/context_layer/pages/
context:
GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/context_layer/pages/
The organization's context wiki: a git repo of Markdown pages hosted by PostHog.
Required: organization_id (path) — ID of the organization you're trying to access. To find the ID of the organization, make a call to /api/organizations/.; path (query) — Repo-relative Markdown path of the page to read.
Optional: head_sha (query) — Head from the first chunk. Required for continuation. A changed head returns 409.; limit (query) — Maximum characters to read. Omit for the full page.; offset (query) — Character offset from next_offset.
